title: couepia dodecandra
intro: Couepia dodecandra, commonly known as "Witch Hazel", is a medicinal plant that has been used for centuries in traditional medicine. It has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe skin irritations, wounds, and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Couepia dodecandra are attributed to its ability to protect against oxidative stress, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
